svg.title: MR-1 wiring schematic on the Octopus Pro v1.1 board
svg.desc: The official BIGTREETECH Octopus Pro V1.1 pin drawing with every connector used by the MR-1 build outlined and routed to what it connects to: four CL57T drives, alarm relays, homes, probe, operator inputs, spindle, coolant and power. Planning drawing; dashed HOLD items are not designed or qualified.
svg.text: Octopus Pro v1.1 → 4 × CL57T V4.1 closed loop · every used connector, routed
PLANNING DRAWING — NOT APPROVAL TO ENERGIZE OR MOVE. Dashed = HOLD (not yet designed or qualified). Printed names on the real board and parts win over this page.
Octopus Pro V1.1 board photo loads from BIGTREETECH when this file is opened
in a browser. The outlines below are at the same positions.
MOTOR0 socket: STEP PF13 · DIR PF12 · GND
P1 ALM → relay K-X A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder, DB15: 6 wires + separate shield
P3 → motor, GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V branch F-X: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED
MOTOR1 socket: STEP PG0 · DIR PG1 · GND
P1 ALM → relay K-YL A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder, DB15: 6 wires + separate shield
P3 → motor, GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V branch F-YL: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED
MOTOR2 socket: STEP PF11 · DIR PG3 · GND
P1 ALM → relay K-Z A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder, DB15: 6 wires + separate shield
P3 → motor, GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V branch F-Z: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED
MOTOR3 socket: STEP PG4 · DIR PC1 · GND
P1 ALM → relay K-YR A2 · COM− → ALM 0V
P2 ← encoder, DB15: 6 wires + separate shield
P3 → motor, GX16: A+ A− B+ B− (pins 1–4)
P4 ← 36 V branch F-YR: +VDC / GND, POLARIZED

HV / VM / VIN jumper caps: REMOVE (all 8)
M0–M7 DIAG caps: REMOVE (they sit on the
Nothing plugs into a socket; the control
cable lands on STEP, DIR, GND only.
Dual-channel E-stop → safety relay. On stop:
· motion contactor opens 36 V (plan Z drop)
· coolant pump and air supply cut
36 V PSU S-360-36 → fused F-X F-YL F-Z F-YR
→ each CL57T P4. Never to the Octopus.
VCC_IO +5 V (orange dot) → F_CMD 0.5 A fast
One takeoff only; other sockets’ VCC_IO unused.
Remove J68 (USB power) for cabinet use.
+24 V → +VIN · 0 V → GND (read the board marks)
24 V only, 28 V max. 36 V kills the board.
Also feeds PS-ALM and the interposing relays.
All EMPTY. Drive power never touches the board.
HE1 · PA3 → mist / air relay coil
Coil across HE+ (fused VIN) and HE−.
Pump and air supply in the stop chain.
Never join them because they say GND.
Bond backplate, frame, DIN rail, spindle
chassis and each drive chassis to PE.
Never use PE or a shield as a return.
Data only. J68 removed for the cabinet.

onboard SW2 shares PB2: guard it
TB PF3 ← E-stop relay monitor contact
T1 PF5 ← touch probe, HW-399 OUT1

Never land Octopus pins on the DB44.

STOP6 PG14 Z · STOP7 PG15 YR

Each outlined connector on the board has
